styles.label: Art
styles.blurb: Rubens, Van Eyck and the MAS museum.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Cathedral, Grote Markt and the old port.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Belgian beer, waffles and Flemish cooking.

stays.why: Walk to the cathedral, Grote Markt and museums. Best for first-timers.
Quiet streets with galleries, bars and the Museum of Fine Arts nearby.
Next to the grand Antwerp Central station; easy train links and good value.
Old docks, the MAS museum and modern waterfront hotels.

food: Try Flemish classics: stoofvlees (beer-braised beef), vol-au-vent and waterzooi.
Belgian beer is the local drink. Ask for a small tasting glass and try a few.
Waffles and chocolate shops are everywhere in the centre; prices rise near the cathedral.
Look for lunch deals (dagschotel) at cafés away from the Grote Markt for better value.
Book dinner on weekends; popular places in Het Zuid fill up.
more_time: Swap a city afternoon for a short train ride to Mechelen or Ghent; check times on the day.
Add a half-day at the Plantin-Moretus Museum, a UNESCO-listed printing house.
Take a walk or bike ride along the Scheldt river and the old docks in Eilandje.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the cathedral, the main museums and a relaxed evening of beer and food.

month_notes: Jan: cold, highs near 7°C, rain on about 14 days. Pack a warm waterproof coat.
Feb: still cold, highs near 9°C, rain on about 13 days.
Mar: cool, highs near 11°C, rain on about 14 days. Bring an umbrella.
Apr: milder, highs near 14°C, rain on about 11 days.
May: pleasant, highs near 19°C, rain on about 12 days.
Jun: warm, highs near 22°C, rain on about 11 days.
Jul: warmest month, highs near 23°C, rain on about 12 days.
Aug: warm, highs near 23°C, rain on about 12 days.
Sep: mild, highs near 20°C, rain on about 12 days.
Oct: cooler, highs near 16°C, rain on about 13 days.
Nov: cold, highs near 10°C, rain on about 14 days.
Dec: cold, highs near 8°C, rain on about 14 days. Expect short daylight.

climate_guide.summary: Temperate maritime climate: mild summers, cool winters, and rain in every month.

items.title: Best time: May to September
items.text: Highs of 19–23°C and long days. Good for walking the centre and the docks.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: About 11–14 rain days every month. Carry a small umbrella or rain jacket.

items.title: Cool winters
items.text: December to February highs of 7–9°C and lows near 2°C. Dress in layers.

items.title: Mild, not hot, summers
items.text: July and August peak near 23°C. Rarely need air-conditioning.

items.title: Windy and changeable
items.text: Weather can shift within a day. Check the forecast each morning.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Waterproof shoes, a rain layer, and a warm jumper for evenings, even in summer.

transit.best: Walk the compact centre; use trams for longer hops.

modes.text: Pre-metro trams run underground in the centre. Buy a ticket before you ride.
De Lijn buses and trams share tickets. A 10-fare card costs about €21.
Trams reach most sights. Single fares last one hour; pay contactless, cash is not accepted.
Uber and Bolt work in Antwerp. Taxis wait at the station and main squares.
Narrow streets and a low-emission zone make driving awkward. Register foreign cars before entering.
The centre is compact and walkable. Many streets are narrow and slow for cars.
Bikes are popular. Cycle superhighways F1, F4 and F14 reach the city.
